```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Vout pinned at VDD with M2 in triode: likely bug where n.M got per-finger W2 plus m=nf, multiplying M2 width ~nf times. Fix: M2 as a single total-width device, MN4 sized at its real Vds so Imir is exact, Lp default lowered so gain ~36 dB and f3dB clears 5 MHz."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I1":     (88e-6, 70e-6, 95e-6),    # main branch current
    "Ln":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),          # input device L
    "Lp":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.2),          # PMOS mirror/load L
    "gmid_p": (9.0, 6.0, 13.0),         # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Imir":   (6e-6, 4e-6, 10e-6),      # mirror branch current
    "vout_t": (0.9, 0.75, 1.05),        # target output DC level (sizing point)
    "trim":   (1.0, 0.85, 1.15),        # load-strength trim (sets vout DC)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vin = spec.get("vin_dc", 0.75)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    I1, Ln, Lp, Imir, vt, trim = p["I1"], p["Ln"], p["Lp"], p["Imir"], p["vout_t"], p["trim"]

    # --- M1: gm/Id such that VGS = vin at I1 (Vds = target vout)
    lo, hi = 4.0, 26.0
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        o = lut.size("n", mid, Ln, I1, vds=vt)
        if o.vgs > vin:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    m1 = lut.size("n", 0.5 * (lo + hi), Ln, I1, vds=vt)

    # --- PMOS diode M3 (sets VSG for M2)
    mp3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, Imir, vds=1.0)
    mp3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, Imir, vds=mp3.vgs)
    vsg = mp3.vgs

    # --- bias: ibias diode -> NMOS mirror MN4 (sized at its real Vds)
    m_ref = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.65)
    m_ref = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=m_ref.vgs)
    m_n4 = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, Imir, vds=max(vdd - vsg, 0.3))

    # --- M2: same L, same gm/Id as M3 (same VSG), sized for I1 at Vsd = vdd - vt; single device, total W
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, I1, vds=vdd - vt)
    W2 = max(0.42, min(trim * m2.W, 2000.0))

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.M("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W2, Lp, m=1)
    n.dev("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp3)
    n.dev("MN3", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_ref)
    n.dev("MN4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_n4)

    # --- predictions at intended operating point
    gds_t = m1.gds + m2.gds
    ctot = cl + m1.cdd + m2.cdd + m1.cgd
    A = m1.gm / gds_t
    f3 = gds_t / (2 * PI * ctot)
    gbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * ctot)
    vov_p = max(vsg - abs(mp3.vth), 0.05)
    swing = (vdd - vov_p - 0.1) - (m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    power = vdd * (iref + Imir + I1)
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A), "f3db": f3, "gbw": gbw, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vt, "swing": swing}
```
